id.description: Unique, concise identifier for the node (e.g., 'setup_db', 'click_login_button').

type.description: Categorizes the node's role in the bug reproduction.

label.description: Short, human-readable label for display on the graph (e.g., 'Database Setup', 'Login Attempt').

description.description: Detailed explanation of the node's content or significance. For logs/errors, a summary.

sequence_number.description: Optional: Order for 'user_action' nodes or other sequential steps in reproduction.

source_text_reference.description: Optional: Snippet from the original issue text this node is derived from.

metadata.description: Optional: Additional key-value details like file paths, versions, commands.

command_executed.description: A specific command that was run.

source.description: ID of the source node for the edge.

target.description: ID of the target node for the edge.

label.description: Describes the high-level relationship: THEN (sequential steps), RESULTS_IN (causal outcome), REQUIRES (prerequisite), REFERENCES (contextual link).

description.description: Optional: Further detail about the edge relationship.

issue_title.description: Original title of the GitHub issue.

issue_number.description: Original number of the GitHub issue.

developer_takeaway.description: A very concise (1-2 sentence) actionable insight or key focus area for the developer.

overall_complexity.description: Estimated complexity to reproduce the bug (low, medium, high).

number_of_steps.description: Estimated number of distinct user actions or setup steps to reproduce.
